name: Data.hasParahoricType_chosenGLRep
summary: The block condition is the definition of b. For k integral at w, block triangular mod w with block x, the hypothesis turns the right translate of f into pi(atSplit(v, k)) u, and smul_chosenGLRep_eq computes this as psi_w(det x)^(-1) chosenGLRep(x at i)(u); its hypothesis on the reductions holds at i by the block structure and trivially elsewhere.

steps.claim: The first part of HasParahoricType: b(c) = 0 exactly for c in the image of incl(O), by the definition of b. For the second part let k be integral at w, with reduction block triangular (a) and incl-block g (b).
steps.lean:
use by simp, fun k g a b ↦ e _ ▸ congr($(O.smul_chosenGLRep_eq u (Sum.rec (Pi.mulSingle i g) 1)
    (reduceFamily_atSplit (.inl i) k) (Sum.rec (fun j ↦ ?_) (by simp))).1).symm.trans (by
    simp +contextual [Finset.prod_eq_single i, -Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.val_det_apply]; rfl)

steps.claim: By the hypothesis the right translate of f by atSplit(v, k) is pi(atSplit(v, k)) u. Apply smul_chosenGLRep_eq with s = (g at the place i, 1 elsewhere) and tau the reductions of atSplit(v, k), which are the reduction of k at i and 1 elsewhere: pi(atSplit(v, k)) u = prod_j psi_j(det s_j)^(-1) chosenGLRep(O, pi)(s at M)(u), and the product reduces to its factor at i, psi(O, w)(det g)^(-1). It remains to check, at every place j of the pair, the block condition tau_j incl = incl s_j of smul_chosenGLRep_eq.
steps.lean:
fun k g a b ↦ e _ ▸ congr($(O.smul_chosenGLRep_eq u (Sum.rec (Pi.mulSingle i g) 1)
    (reduceFamily_atSplit (.inl i) k) (Sum.rec (fun j ↦ ?_) (by simp))).1).symm.trans (by
    simp +contextual [Finset.prod_eq_single i, -Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.val_det_apply]; rfl)

steps.claim: At a place j other than i both sides are the inclusion matrix (tau_j = 1, s_j = 1); it remains the place j = i.
steps.lean: obtain rfl | _ := eq_or_ne j i <;> simp [*]

steps.claim: At j = i: the reduction of k is block triangular with incl-block g, so (reduction of k) incl = incl g.
